source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Fetching only item IDs during EWS folder sync required many extra GetItem requests. The measured result was more requests and worse overall time despite a faster individual request. Ask for the fields needed for create, read, update, and delete work in SyncFolderItems, then handle items from that response.
title: Fetch Exchange sync fields in the SyncFolderItems request
